objective: Port netty-codec-redis (io.netty.handler.codec.redis (RESP codec)) with its original tests: Java names (case and the Async suffix may differ), the original structure and every original comment, and an explicit evidence-backed record for each CLR adaptation and each unit that is not ported.

ownerDecisions: Project, folder and assembly names are the namespace root of the module (owner decision 2026-11-19, see docs/codec-base-porting.md): each codec module takes the namespace of its main package, and the tests use <project>.Tests like the other test projects.

Owner decisions 2026-11-19 for the codec modules that only need codec-base: one project per Maven module; codec-socks is Netty.NET.Handler.Codec.Socks (its Maven and JPMS name) and holds the socks and socksx namespaces; haproxy is HAProxy (the casing of the Java types in that package); socksx, v4 and v5 are Socksx, V4 and V5.

statusMeaning.verified: Every declared original test is mapped to a C# test with the same name (case may differ) and passes.
statusMeaning.clr-adapted: Ported with the original names, structure and comments; every CLR difference is stated in a // CLR: comment and in this entry. For tests, some original methods are CLR-inapplicable with recorded evidence.
statusMeaning.deprecated-not-ported: @Deprecated Java unit (or a helper serving one) that is not ported; the deprecation facts, reason, replacement and every original comment/test are recorded.
statusMeaning.jvm-only-replaced: JVM-only metadata or documentation unit replaced by its recorded CLR counterpart.

The overrides of the virtual DefaultByteBufHolder members (copy, duplicate, retainedDuplicate, replace, retain, touch) are C# covariant override returns; content() is the Content property; no explicit bridges are needed because the DefaultByteBufHolder members implement IByteBufHolder/IReferenceCounted.
Sealed class; covariant override returns narrowing to ILastBulkStringRedisContent.
Sealed class as the final source class. @UnstableApi is the Common [UnstableApi] attribute.

HashMap is Dictionary (GetValueOrDefault returns null as HashMap.get; a null string/ByteBuf key returns null, because HashMap permits a null key and Dictionary throws ArgumentNullException). LongObjectMap/LongObjectHashMap (io.netty.util.collection; owner decision 2026-11-19 keeps Dictionary, recorded in docs/common-porting-manifest.json) is Dictionary<long, V>: Java needs the primitive map because type arguments must be reference types (JLS 4.5.1), while the CLR specializes Dictionary<long, V> for the long key without boxing. The simple enum RedisReplyKey is a C# enum (name() is ToString(), values() is Enum.GetValues<RedisReplyKey>(), sorted by value and so in declaration order); RedisErrorKey, a Java enum with a constructor, field and toString(), is a sealed class with static readonly instances and a Values() method in declaration order. new String(buffer.array()) decodes the same bytes with ToString(Encoding.Default), because ByteBuf.array() has no C# counterpart; value.name().getBytes(UTF_8) is Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes.

Covariant overrides of the virtual DefaultByteBufHolder members, including content()/refCnt() as the Content/RefCnt properties and release()/release(int) in NULL_INSTANCE/EMPTY_INSTANCE, whose anonymous classes are the nested classes NullFullBulkStringRedisMessage and EmptyFullBulkStringRedisMessage. The module interfaces declare no narrowing members (owner decision 2026-11-19), so DefaultByteBufHolder implements all holder members and no explicit implementation is needed. Internal sealed class with the private constructor; Long.toString is the invariant-culture text and US_ASCII is Encoding.ASCII; PlatformDependent.BIG_ENDIAN_NATIVE_ORDER is the Common field. The (byte) casts of shortToBytes keep the same bits as System.Byte; the only sign-dependent use (the delimiter text) is in RedisDecoder.

Internal sealed class with the private constructor; compile-time constants are const, NULL_SHORT/EOL_SHORT and REDIS_MAX_ARRAY_LENGTH (SystemPropertyUtil.GetInt of the Common port) are static readonly.

The private enum State is a C# enum. RedisMessageType constants are static readonly instances, not compile-time constants, so the switch statements on a RedisMessageType are if/else chains comparing by reference. ByteProcessor is Func<byte, bool>, passed as the ToPositiveLongProcessor.Process method group. Sign: readEndOfLine prints the delimiter bytes as Java signed bytes ((sbyte) of the System.Byte values) and ToPositiveLongProcessor prints the rejected byte as (sbyte); a byte of 0x80..0xFF is rejected in both languages (above '9' unsigned, below '0' signed). catch (RedisCodecException e) { ...; throw e; } is throw; (same exception object). Numbers in messages and toString() use the invariant culture, because Java decimal text does not depend on a culture while Int32/Int64.ToString() and StringBuilder.Append(Int64) use the current culture.

MessageToMessageEncoder<IRedisMessage> with typeof(IRedisMessage); ByteBufAllocator is IByteBufAllocator (ioBuffer is IoBuffer); ByteBufUtil.utf8MaxBytes/writeUtf8 take the string as ReadOnlySpan<char>; content() of the holders is the Content property. catch (CodecException e) { throw e; } is throw;.
